messages:
sarah-support: Heads-up — Medivex procurement emailed: they won't accept invoice until we provide a Purchasing Authority ID (PAID) and an approved SOW reference. They attached their vendor form.
alec-account-exec: Ugh. Did they share the exact field format? example value?
sarah-support: Yep: 'PAID-XXXX-YYYY' format they said. Also they want the SOW ref as 'SOW-Redwood-<customer_contract_id>'. They sent vendor_w9_and_forms.pdf link: https://files.example.com/medivex/vendor_forms.pdf
julia-billing: Can we attach PAID to the invoice metadata? Our billing system supports custom refs but needs the exact string before we push invoice.
mike-finance: We can add a line for "Procurement Ref: PAID-..." but finance needs the signed SOW or a PO number from buyer to recognize as invoiceable.
emily-cs: Medivex legal already confirmed SOW content, but procurement won't accept just confirmation email. They're insisting on the PAID coming from their procurement portal.
alec-account-exec: @mike-finance any chance we can issue a pro-forma until they post a formal PO? Customer is asking for immediate usage credits.
mike-finance: We can issue a pro-forma, but no revenue recognized. If they want official invoice we need either the PAID string or a formal PO uploaded. Also need billing contact and tax/VAT details — Medivex is EU-registered?
emily-cs: They're UK-based and provided VAT ID in the vendor form. VAT verified.
julia-billing: Ok. I'll prepare a pro-forma and include a note: "Awaiting PAID/PO for official invoice — see attached SOW ref". Uploading to billing portal now.
invoice-bot: Invoice draft created: draft-6321 by julia-billing. "Procurement Ref" field left blank.
sarah-support: I'll ping the buyer contact now and ask them to post PAID or PO in the procurement portal. Copying the exact format they requested to avoid back-and-forth.
alec-account-exec: Thanks. If they push the PAID today we can finalize invoice tomorrow. If not, escalate to procurement ops and send credit hold notice.
mike-finance: Also flag for collections if >30 days. For now pro-forma + SOW ref is fine.
emily-cs: Noted. I'll update the customer success playbook with this PAID requirement for Medivex to avoid future confusion. :memo:
sarah-support: Update: buyer replied — will submit PAID by EOD and attach PO. I'll post confirmation here when received.
alec-account-exec: Great, keep us posted. :thumbsup:
